item.title: Quadruple amputee professional cornhole player accused of murder in Maryland - WDEF
item.description: A professional cornhole player and quadruple amputee was arrested and charged with murder in Maryland, authorities said.

item.title: Whitener Drive house damaged following fire - WDEF
item.description: A home has suffered damage following a house fire on Whitener Drive in Dalton.

item.title: Oil prices rise and stocks fall as war with Iran advances despite Trump's talk of negotiations - WDEF
item.description: With airstrikes still battering Iran and missiles still targeting sites across the Middle East, some of the optimism that sent stocks rallying the day before drained out of Wall Street on Tuesday.

item.title: Pakistan says it’s ready to host talks aimed at ending the Iran war - WDEF
item.description: Pakistan’s prime minister says his country is ready to “facilitate meaningful and conclusive talks” to end the Iran war.

item.title: 17-year-old suffers gunshot wound in Arlington Avenue shooting - WDEF
item.description: A 17-year-old suffered a gunshot wound following a shooting on the 1100 block of Arlington Avenue on March 23, 2026.

item.title: Trump claims the war "has been won," and "we have, really, regime change" - WDEF
item.description: President Trump voiced optimism on Tuesday that a peace deal will be reached with Iran, while insisting the war had already been won.

item.title: Teens charged with burglary after break-ins at local apartment complex - WDEF
item.description: Three teens have been charged following reports cars being broken into at an apartment complex.

item.title: Survivor Inspires Hope Through Story - WDEF
item.description: Burn survivor John O’Leary shared his extraordinary journey at Siskin Hospital’s Possibilities Luncheon, inspiring hope and resilience in patients and attendees alike.

item.title: Iranian media say regime has rejected Trump admin's proposals as "excessive and disconnected from the reality" of the war - WDEF
item.description: Iran's state-owned Press TV network said Wednesday that the regime had rejected terms presented by the Trump administration to end the war launched by the U.S. and Israel on Feb. 28.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie in NBC News interview appeals for help finding her missing mother - WDEF
item.description: A tearful Savannah Guthrie, in her first interview since her 84-year-old mother was apparently abducted from her Arizona home, said that “someone needs to do the right thing” and come forward with information to help the investigation.

item.title: Brush fire danger warning across our area - WDEF
item.description: The Pisgah Fire Department posted video of the danger of brush fires around our area.

item.title: Bill debate could force overhaul of Chattanooga Airport - WDEF
item.description: Tennessee lawmakers are discussing changes that would affect the Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport.

item.title: Iran dismisses US ceasefire plan, issues counterproposal as strikes land across the Mideast - WDEF
item.description: Iran on Wednesday dismissed an American plan to pause the war in the Middle East and launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries, including an assault that sparked a huge fire at Kuwait International Airport.

item.title: Record share of Americans carry credit card debt, can't pay monthly bills - WDEF
item.description: A record share of Americans are unable to pay off their monthly credit card bills, compounding money woes for U.S. residents grappling with affordability concerns, according to a recent analysis.

item.title: North Carolina parts ways with men’s basketball coach Hubert Davis after 5 seasons - WDEF
item.description: Hubert Davis appeared to be the right coach to be North Carolina’s bridge from Dean Smith to Roy Williams and into the future. Instead, that run lasted just five years.
